name: council-of-elrond
description: A council of specialist reviewers that gates risky tool calls before they run. Rules decide the tier; model members give a second opinion; anything uncertain comes to you.

gandalfEnabled.title: Gandalf (destructive operations) enabled
gandalfEnabled.description: Off: calls Gandalf would review go straight to you instead.

gandalfModel.title: Gandalf model
gandalfModel.description: "default" uses the project rules file's choice, else the built-in default (sonnet).

legolasEnabled.title: Legolas (diffs) enabled
legolasEnabled.description: Off: file edits and writes Legolas would review go to Gandalf instead (or to you, if Gandalf is off too).

legolasModel.title: Legolas model
legolasModel.description: "default" uses the project rules file's choice, else the built-in default (sonnet).

aragornEnabled.title: Aragorn (git and databases) enabled
aragornEnabled.description: Off: git history and database calls Aragorn would review go to Gandalf instead (or to you, if Gandalf is off too).

aragornModel.title: Aragorn model
aragornModel.description: "default" uses the project rules file's choice, else the built-in default (opus).

councilEnabled.title: Full council for big operations
councilEnabled.description: Big operations (by default a git push, a merge into a protected branch, a migration; bigOperations in the rules file) go to every enabled reviewer at once, with the project checks. Off: one reviewer takes them, as for any other call.

councilModel.title: Full council model
councilModel.description: The model every reviewer uses when it sits on the full council. "default" uses the project rules file's choice, else the built-in default (opus).

councilSequential.title: Full council one at a time
councilSequential.description: Asks the council's reviewers one after another under the same deadline, stopping at the first block, instead of all at once. Slower; can spend fewer tokens.

gimliEnabled.title: Project checks enabled
gimliEnabled.description: Runs the commands in gimli.commands of the rules file (tests, lint, typecheck) alongside the full council; a failing check blocks. Each has its own timeout (120 s unless set, at most 600 s).

shadowMode.title: Shadow mode
shadowMode.description: Reviewers run and log their verdicts but never refuse. Block rules, protected paths and the secrets scan still enforce. Recommended for the first days. /council shadow on|off switches it for one session.

gollumEnabled.title: Secrets scan enabled
gollumEnabled.description: Scans what gated calls would write or run for secrets: high-confidence finds are refused, possible ones come to you.

galadrielEnabled.title: Read-only preview enabled
galadrielEnabled.description: Before a review, runs fixed read-only inspections (delete targets, the commits a push would send, a file's diff) and shows the result to the reviewer and to you.

previewLines.title: Preview line limit
previewLines.description: Lines of the read-only preview kept for the reviewer.

diffLines.title: Diff line limit
diffLines.description: Lines of a file change's diff kept for the reviewer.

reviewDeadlineSeconds.title: Review deadline (seconds)
reviewDeadlineSeconds.description: How long one model review may take before it counts as a block and comes to you. 0 picks a deadline from the model (sonnet 30, opus 45, fable 90).

tokenBudget.title: Session token budget
tokenBudget.description: Tokens all reviewers may spend in one session. Once spent, gated calls come to you.

toolErrorsAreWipes.title: Tool errors count as failed attempts
toolErrorsAreWipes.description: A gated call that ran and errored counts toward the lockout (3 on one operation, 5 on one kind, per prompt).

auditLogPath.title: Audit log path
auditLogPath.description: JSONL audit log, relative to the project root unless absolute.

auditMaxKb.title: Audit log size before rotation (KB)
auditMaxKb.description: The log rotates past this size; three files are kept.
